What I owe you

Open it when you have a quiet minute.

Dear Bubbles,

I am sorry. Not in the quick way I have said it before, but properly.

I hurt you when I do all the things I do. There is no good reason for it, and I will not give you a list of reasons that sound like excuses.Your feelings were right, and I should have listened the first time.

Hold me to both. If I slip, tell me directly and I will not argue about how you said it.

You have been more patient with me than I earned. I do not take that for granted.

Yours, Monish
